# Data source description

Load data reading libraries

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r load-and-inspect-dataset, eval=FALSE}
data_wsb2022_raw = read_csv("./data/wallstreetbets_2022.csv")

data_wsb2022_raw |>
  head(5) |>
  kable()

data_wsb2022_postonly = data_wsb2022_raw |>
  filter(title != "Comment")

data_wsb2022_postonly

nrow(data_wsb2022_raw)
nrow(data_wsb2022_postonly)

data_wsb2022_postonly |>
  write_csv("./data/wsb_2022_postonly.csv")
```



```{r sarcasm-dataset}
data_wsb2022_sarcasm = read_csv("./data/wsb_2022_postonly_sarcasm.csv")
data_wsb2022_sarcasm |>
  head(5)

data = data_wsb2022_sarcasm |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    created_ny_time = format(
      lubridate::with_tz(lubridate::as_datetime(created, tz = "UTC"), tzone = "America/New_York"),
      "%H:%M:%S"
    ),
    created_ny_hour_bin = {
      ny_hour = as.integer(substr(created_ny_time, 1L, 2L))
      hour_label = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(ny_hour), NA_character_, paste0(ny_hour, "-", (ny_hour + 1L) %% 24L)
      )
      factor(hour_label, levels = paste0(0:23, "-", (1:24) %% 24), ordered = TRUE)
    },
    no_body = is.na(body) | trimws(body) == "",
    body_work_count = stringr::str_count(dplyr::coalesce(body, ""), "\\S+"),
    link_only = {
      body_text = stringr::str_trim(dplyr::coalesce(body, ""))
      (stringr::str_detect(body_text, "(?i)^https?://\\S+$") |
        stringr::str_detect(body_text, "(?i)^\\[[^\\]]+\\]\\(https?://\\S+\\)$")) &
        !stringr::str_detect(
          body_text,
          "(?i)https?://(?:[a-z0-9-]+\\.)*(?:reddit\\.com|redd\\.it)(?=[:/?#]|$)"
        )
    }
  )

data |>
  head(5) |>
  kable()

colnames(data)
```
